name: Shinjou Yuu
source:
She is a popular girl in her grade who is friendly and can easily get along with those around her. She sometimes does unexpected things that surprise those around her, despite having a flashy personality she is passive when it comes to romance. Although she is very popular, she desires to have same-sex friends. She has a talent for bringing people together, but never comes across as rude.

After starting school, she becomes infatuated with the protagonist due to a certain incident. (She has noticed the protagonist's interest in her a little bit.)
